Class Crow

game.crow.Crow
All Implemented Interfaces:
Printable, Composure, ItemCache, StatefulCreature
public class Crow extends ConsciousActor implements StatefulCreature, ItemCache, Composure
A crow: a stateful creature that cycles between Perching, Foraging, Mobbing, and Fleeing.

  • Field Details

    • SENSING_RADIUS

      public static final int SENSING_RADIUS
      How far (in tiles) the crow can sense items and actors around it. Kept small because the farm is only 10x7: a wider radius covers nearly the whole farm, so the wandering animals and Merchant would always count as a crowd and the crow would never leave Fleeing.
